🎵 Lyrics:

Let's get the party started
See you at the bar, you was hardly talkin'
That's when I knew that your heart was scarrin'
Friends to lovers, need a part to star in, like, "Wait, babe"
Let me ask your pardon
This ain't Gucci, this is Prada, darlin'
If you want somethin', you can ask me, darlin'
Then you started laughin' 'cause you think I'm jokin'
But lookin' in your eyes is the best thing
Brake lights givin' you the red skin
You was in a bad mood from we stepped in
Though you checked out 'fore we even checked in
On the phone you gon' vent to your best friend
The one who gave me the lecture, but I ain't gon' sweat you, babe
I'ma let you catch up with your boy, undress you
And let me tell you why I'ma bless you

[Chorus: Tems]
It's the way my mind fallin' away
In my heart, I know
You feel the same when you're with me
You know I'm all you need
You're where I wanna be
My darling, can't you see?

[Post-Chorus: Tems]
I love you, I love you
I love you, I love you
I love you

[Verse 2: Tems & Dave]
Fell into you
Say you want me in the mood
Tryna hide my feelings for you
Don't wanna argue, not with you
Tell me why you're so in denial
Hold me close, don't tell me goodnight
Are you down to get me?
Tell me when you're ready, I'm ready (Yeah)

[Verse 3: Dave & Tems]
We can get into it or we can get intimate
The shower when you sing in it
Better than Beyoncé, I like the sound of fiancée
You know, it's got a little ring to it
And really when I think of it
Growin' up, I didn't ever see marriages
No weddings, no horse, no carriages
I wanna do things different and change the narrative
God knows you a wild child, beautiful child, I need your help
Lookin' like you come from the '90s by yourself
My mum sixty-one and her favourite line to tell her son is
Sometimes she wish that she had a girl (Girl)
I wanna take you back to a time, back to a trip
You had that white wine that I never got to sip
And dinner wasn't ruined 'cause you never got to pick
I know that everybody told me that I'm sick 'cause

[Chorus: Tems]
It's the way my mind fallin' away
In my heart, I know
You feel the same when you're with me
You know I'm all you need
You're where I wanna be
My darling, can't you see?

[Post-Chorus: Tems, Tems & Dave]
(I love you) Me and you, never let me go
(I love you) Me and you, I'll tell you two times
Me and you, never let me go
(I love you) Me and you, I'll tell you two times
It's me and you, never let me go
(I love you) Me and you, I'll tell you two times
Me and you, never let me go
Me and you, I'll tell you two times

[Bridge: Dave & Tems]
I said lean with it, rock with it (You're the only one I want)
Your finger, I can put a rock in it (You're the only one, my baby)
Finger, I can put a rock in it (You're the only one I want)
Banker, they can put a block in it (You're the only one, my baby)
Said rock with it, bounce with it (You're the only one I want)
Your left wrist, I can put my house in it (You're the only one, my baby)
You wanna bet, babe? I can put my house in it (You're the only one I want)
Babe, I could put my spouse in it (You're the only one, my baby)

[Outro: Dave]
I said shimmy-shimmy, yay, shimmy, shimmy-shimmy, yah
5'9", brown eyes, and she in it, in it
Shimmy-shimmy, yay, shimmy, shimmy-shimmy, yah

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: Hammer's Dracula | Official Teaser Trailer | The Cut The Censors Tried To Bury
snippet.description:
The Count is coming, and he's bringing long-lost footage unseen for over 60 years.

This October, Peter Cushing and Christopher Lee are together again as Hammer's original Dracula returns to cinemas and makes its worldwide home entertainment debut in stunning 4K.

Painstakingly restored in 4K from the best original archival materials sourced from around the world, Dracula (1958) returns in its most complete form ever presented. For the first time outside of Japan's original 1958 theatrical release, footage believed lost for over six decades has been meticulously restored and reintegrated into the film. This footage has never been released in the UK or the US, and has never been seen on home entertainment anywhere in the world.

This is the cut the censors tried to bury.

The Count awaits. Sign up for updates at hammerfilms.com/dracula

The legacy lives on. Subscribe now.

snippet.title: Bruno Mars - Risk It All [Live From The Romantic Tour]
snippet.description:
Bruno Mars - Risk It All [Live From The Romantic Tour]

The Romantic – the new album from Bruno Mars, available now. Listen now: https://brunomars.lnk.to/TheRomantic

Lyrics: 
For just a chance to win your heart
you could set the bar
beyond the stars
I’ll do anything anything you ask me to

Say you want the moon watch me learn to fly
Ain't a mountain you could point to i wouldn’t climb
It's crazy but it’s true. There’s nothing I won't do. 
I’d risk it all for you

To hold your hand and call you mine
I’m trynna be your man
til the end of time
oh i’ll do anything, anything you ask me to

I would run through the fire just to be by your side
if your heart’s on the line you could take mine
It's crazy but it’s true. There's nothing I won’t do. 
I'd risk it all for you

I would swim across the sea just to show you
sacrifice my life just to hold you
I could go on and on to prove that you belong
here in my arms

Say you want the moon watch me, learn to fly
ain’t a mountain you could point to I wouldn’t climb

It's crazy but it’s true. There's nothing I won’t do
I’d risk it all for you (2x)

Bruno Mars is a 16x GRAMMY®-winning global superstar, singer, songwriter, multi-instrumentalist, producer, and one of the most-streamed artists in the world. Known for his showmanship and chart-toppers, Bruno has set a number of records throughout his career, including becoming the first artist ever to hit 150 million monthly listeners on Spotify, appearing on two of the fastest songs to reach one billion streams (for “Die with a Smile” with Lady Gaga and “APT.” with ROSÉ, and achieving the highest-certified song in RIAA history with 2010’s “Just the Way You Are”). Since launching a string of hits beginning in 2009, Bruno has sold over 150 million records worldwide, making him one of the best-selling artists of all time. Beyond his work as a soloist, Bruno is a member of the duo Silk Sonic with Anderson .Paak. In addition to his 35 Billboard Hot 100 hits, including nine number one singles, Bruno is the recipient of 16 GRAMMY® Awards (including “Album of the Year” for 24K Magic), 14 American Music Awards, and seven MTV Video Music Awards. His 24K Magic World Tour was among the highest-grossing tours in history, and within the top ten highest-grossing of the 2010s.

#BrunoMars #RiskItAll #TheRomanticTour

snippet.title: F1 25: 2026 Season Pack Features Deep Dive
snippet.description:
Rewrite the Grid when the 2026 Season Pack for EA SPORTS™ F1® 25 launches worldwide on June 3, 2026. Wishlist now: https://x.ea.com/89231

Wishlist the F1® 25: 2026 Season Pack on Xbox Series X|S, Steam, and EA Play.

In this deep dive, you'll learn all about the groundbreaking new era of F1® and the 2026 rules and regulations. 

Get ready for action-packed racing as you tactically use the new Overtake mode and active aerodynamics to outsmart the grid and propel yourself to victory. 

Master the new MADRING circuit and forge your racing legacy to fight for Championship Glory in Career mode, or take control of your own team and become the 12th team on the grid in My Team, where you can customize your car and line up alongside new teams, Audi and Cadillac. 

Jump into the 2026 Season across Driver Career, My Team, Grand Prix™, Time Trial, Split-Screen, and Unranked Multiplayer modes. In Driver Career and My Team, start a new 2026 save to get the latest teams, drivers, rules, fresh Objectives, and an updated Calendar featuring the new Spanish Grand Prix™. In My Team, your custom squad will now be the twelfth on the grid, as the official grid expands to eleven teams in 2026.

Follow all the EA SPORTS F1 social channels 👉 https://linktr.ee/easportsf1

https://x.com/EASPORTSF1

https://www.instagram.com/EASPORTSF1

snippet.title: Game Developer VS 𝔹ℝ𝕀𝕋𝕀𝕊ℍ - Tiny Terraces A PERFECTLY BALANCED GAME WITH NO EXPLOITS
snippet.description:
Welcome To Tiny Terraces a fantastic farming tycoon game made by a fantastically talented solo developer. It is a mix between stardew valley and an idle game with a simple core focus on building a tiny terrace and slowly automating the entire farming process like you would in a normal game of factorio. However The developer has made one terrible mistake they have wrongly used an American flag as the icon for the English language of the game. I simply cannot let this stand and so it is up to the spiffing brit (Evil British Youtuber and game breaker) to show you how to take a great indie game like tiny terraces and break its balance with the power of path finding bugs. 

Chapters:
00:00 - Intro
01:14 - Our Tiny Terrace
04:52 - Expanding our Work Force
08:00 - Unlocking more items
09:21 - Exploiting the Game
13:15 - Our first steps to Automation
15:31 - The Coffee Trials
18:21 - The Tea Redemption
19:55 - The Tea farm grows!
22:09 - Full scale production
22:53 - Becoming a millionaire
23:40 - Outro & Thanks for Watching!

This is not a sponsored video but if you liked the look of the game you can grab it probably in a steam summer sale here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3136330/Tiny_Terraces/

Its own developer describes it as: A cozy idle farming game, watch tiny guys do tasks around the terrace, expand, progress, and decorate your Tiny Terrace.

Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

snippet.title: 007 First Light Review - The Final Verdict
snippet.description:
Well, we got to play 007 First Light, and we’ve come away very impressed. It’s always great when a game’s creative and technical sides blend well to present a cohesive experience. 

Throw in a solid Bond story with a fresh take on the iconic character, and you’ve got yourself a winner. IO Interactive clearly felt the same and delivered a game that has taken us on a wild ride through the world of espionage and spy craft that MI6 takes for granted. It’s been a blast for many reasons, and we’re delighted to tell you about all of them. Join us for a review of a game whose wait has been well worth the reward.

snippet.title: Grieving a video game & the Loss of Destiny as a 3rd Space.
snippet.description:
Might as well sign that one petition, and sign in on June 9th: https://www.change.org/p/petition-sony-to-develop-destiny-3 Destiny 2's final update has been the cause of a wave of what can only be described as grief for its community. This shouldn't be a surprise given that this was a 3rd space that people relied upon to feel like they belonged. It was a universe that mattered deeply to so many of its players and it deserved better. Today I wanted to talk a little more having processed my own thoughts on the loss of Destiny 2 and what it means for the community to lose its proverbial town square.

If you ignore every time I went forward, it was a perfect run.

snippet.title: so roblox just f*cking destroyed everything
snippet.description:
Roblox just dropped an absolute bombshell update in Australia, and it is honestly terrifying. If you live in Australia, the platform is officially on total lockdown. You can no longer play ANY games—even standard "Minimal" maturity rated games or brain rot slop—without completing an age check and submitting your ID. The play button is GONE and replaced with an "Unlock" button. This isn't just a glitch or a player threshold issue; it’s a forced mandate.

Oceania usually gets hit as the "crash test dummies" for these massive updates first (just like with Roblox Kids), which means this could be coming to the US, the UK, and the rest of the world very soon. Considering only about 50% of the player base has actually verified their ID, this could legitimately kill off half the platform.

⭐ 2nd Channel: https://www.youtube.com/@PwnedExtra
